newsitem.title: USA: Ahmanson unit sells 4 branches for $270 mln.
newsitem.headline: Ahmanson unit sells 4 branches for $270 mln.

text.p: H.F. Ahmanson & Co said Friday its Home Savings of America unit had signed a definitive agreement to sell four Arizona branches to First National Bank of America for $270 million..
First National is a unit of Honolulu-based Bancorp Hawaii Inc. It currently has five offices in the Phoenix area and one in Yuma, Ariz., serving small and mid-sized businesses.
Home Savings said the sale of the four branches is part of its strategy to concentrate business in key retail markets of California, Texas and Florida.
The four branches are located in Tucson, Mesa, Green Valley and Prescott.
Detailed terms of the transaction were not given.
The deal is expected to close in the first quarter of 1997, subject to regulatory approval.
